# Kazumi rule fixtures

English | [简体中文](README.md)

The `*.json` files here are the published Kazumi rules from <https://github.com/Predidit/KazumiRules> (MIT licence, see `LICENSE-KazumiRules.txt`), copied unmodified from commit `e43de53b8b32124d06386ae8df832a0984e24141`.

That repository's `index.json` is an index, not a rule, and is not copied. The rules are used only by `TestParseAllPublishedRules` and are never fetched from the network.
